title: The Undertow of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Z. M. Okafor
blurb: Dominic Crane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
